episodes.title: Understanding Cult Psychology w/ Pia Puolakka
episodes.description: In this episode, we are joined by Pia Puolakka. We discuss what cults are, discuss the process of how cults interact on the victim, describe people that may be vulnerable, as well as define warning signs that a person may be in this type of coercive group. Insights into helping those in this situation were also presented. Pia is a Finnish forensic psychologist, psychotherapist, author, and international criminal justice consultant. Throughout her career, she has worked with offenders, forensic mental health clients, victims, and individuals affected by coercive control and psychological manipulation. In addition to her work in corrections and forensic psychology, she served as Chair of UUT – Support for the Victims of Religions, supporting individuals affected by harmful religious movements, cults, coercive and high-control groups, and other forms of psychological abuse. Today, Pia works internationally on correctional reform, rehabilitation, and the intersection of psychology and technology. Her areas of expertise and interest include psychopathy, cult leadership, coercive control, manipulation, rehabilitation, and the psychology of power.
